    CHAPTER I

The measurements were first published in that year,[2] and the
results were at once disputed by several of his rivals abroad.

A second series was undertaken the following summer,[3] though
the weather was against the observers from beginning to end.

Footnote 2: The second lecture of the Institute, delivered in May.

Footnote 3: The charitable bequests made in that year alone came
to a considerable sum, as the appendix shows in some detail.
